messages:
maya: quick triage — enterprise pilot (FinTech) asked for 7yr audit export + per-tenant search + BYOK/HSM escrow. Q3 target. Need a proposed MVP and launch gating. thoughts?

vikram: short answer: full HSM escrow + search across 7yrs is a pretty big lift. we can split into a small MVP that satisfies pilot while deferring HSM escrow.

dara: agree with vikram. risk-wise BYOK with customer-managed KMS ARN (no HSM escrow) + strong key policies is acceptable for pilot. HSM escrow triggers legal + procurement + additional threat model.

liz: technically for MVP we can do: append-only audit store -> S3 cold archive + Elastic for recent N days. export job that produces a zipped, signed bundle. search SLA for recent window only.

maya: propose concrete MVP so we can align with sales/pilot: 1) on-demand S3 export (customer-initiated) 2) searchable tenant-scoped logs for last 90 days 3) cold archive to S3 with lifecycle to keep up to 7yrs 4) BYOK via customer KMS ARN (no HSM escrow) 5) audit immutability evidence (signed manifests).

vikram: sounds reasonable. rough eng estimate: infra + storage changes (2 sprints), search + APIs (1 sprint), BYOK integration + e2e (1 sprint). total ~4 sprints with 1 oncall-support window for pilot.

ajohnson: launch gating ideas: security sign-off (threat model + key policy review), pilot customer acceptance test (export + integrity check), load test for search SLA, and docs + runbook. also need billing mapping for export retention.

maya: acceptance criteria to share with customer: - exportable audit bundle (JSONL) with signed manifest - ability to provide KMS ARN and have our export encrypted with that key - search of last 90 days with <300ms p50 for common queries - retention purge policy defined and reversible by export.

liz: sample retention config we can expose in the Console/CLI:
```
retention: {
  "hot_window_days": 90,
  "cold_archive": "s3://redwood-tenant-archives/<tenant>/",
  "archive_duration_years": 7
}
```

dara: add to acceptance criteria: tamper-evidence (signed manifest + deterministic export names) and audit access control checks (who downloaded/exported).

maya: decision: ship MVP as proposed, label HSM escrow as "enterprise-grade add-on" for later quarter. @sales — confirm pilot OK with BYOK-as-KMS-ARN (no HSM).

jira-bot: created RL-3421: "MVP audit export + tenant search + BYOK(KMS-ARN)" https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RL-3421

compliance-bot: note: SOC2 evidence checklist items affected: CC6 (system operations logs), CC7 (access logs), and evidence for retention policy. please attach threat model and key policy docs to RL-3421.

maya: thanks — i'll sync with sales and legal, then we'll break down RL-3421 into sub-tasks and scope the first sprint. tagging this thread as "priority-pilot". :thumbsup:

vikram: ack. i'll draft a tech spec PR after we get legal constraints.

liz: will prepare export runbook and retention lifecycle template.

dara: i'll start a key-policy checklist and flag anything that needs legal.

maya: perfect. target: alpha build in 6w. if blockers appear we'll re-triage.
